# Munich Personal RePEc Archive (MPRA)

> > A freely accessible open-access academic repository for economics research papers, working papers, and statistical software components integrated with the RePEc network.

MPRA is hosted by the University of Munich and serves as a central hub for economics researchers to deposit, discover, and share peer-reviewed and working papers. The archive provides browsing, searching, statistics, and feed syndication capabilities for the global economics research community.

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse Items](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/view): Main browsing interface for MPRA economics papers with filtering and search capabilities
- [Latest Additions](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/cgi/latest): Feed of recently added economics papers and working papers to the archive
- [Latest 20 Additions Tool](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/cgi/latest_tool): Quick-view tool displaying the 20 most recent economics research submissions

## Help & Documentation

- [User Documentation](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/help): Comprehensive user documentation for paper submission and repository navigation
- [FAQ](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/faq.html): Frequently asked questions covering archive policies, submissions, and open access principles

## Analytics & Resources

- [Repository Statistics](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/cgi/stats/report): MPRA usage analytics and download metrics reporting tool for research impact assessment
- [Software Components](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/software.html): Information on Statistical Software Components available in MPRA
- [Related Links](https://mpra.ub.uni-muenchen.de/links.html): Quick links to RePEc services and related economics research resources
